summary: The A-01 sign-up screen now matches the approved public sign-up intent closely enough for this audit. It has a branded split hero, mascot/benefit area, required account fields, password rules, terms/privacy links, primary email sign-up CTA, honest disabled Google/social surface, and login escape link. 360/768/1280 captures render without login bounce, Next error overlay, or console errors.

findings.claim: Resolved: the sign-up page presents a branded public entry screen rather than a plain centered form.
findings.observed: The desktop/tablet/mobile captures show Talkpik AI branding, AI TOPIK writing value copy, a mascot visual area, and a three-item benefit strip.
findings.expected: Wireframe regions 1 and 2 require a brand/value message and mascot/benefit area before account creation.

findings.claim: Resolved: the account creation form exposes the required fields, terms consent, and password guidance.
findings.observed: The form contains name, email, password, password confirmation, password-strength rules, terms/privacy consent, and a primary submit CTA. Existing component tests still pass.
findings.expected: Description region 3 requires name, email, password information and validation. Region 4 requires terms agreement and sign-up CTA.

findings.claim: Resolved: the social sign-up branch is visible without pretending a provider is wired.
findings.observed: The current screen shows an 'or' separator, a disabled Google sign-up button, and an explicit social-login preparation notice. DOM inspection confirms the Google button is disabled.
findings.expected: The wireframe/hifi include a social sign-up branch, while current implementation records no provider wiring. The UI should be honest about unavailable external auth.
findings.recommendedNextAction: No blocking follow-up unless product scope opens real OAuth provider integration.

findings.claim: Resolved: desktop, tablet, and mobile renders are stable for the public sign-up route.
findings.observed: render-shot captured 360, 768, and 1280 viewports at /sign-up with status 200, errorOverlay=false, and consoleErr=0. Scoped Playwright A-01 e2e passed on mobile-360, tablet-768, and desktop-1280.
findings.expected: A public sign-up route should render without auth redirect, error overlay, console errors, or CTA/text collisions across audited breakpoints.
